# copy

> Apply a [JSON Patch][json-patch] ([RFC 6902][rfc-6902]) `copy` operation to a document immutably.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var copyOp = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/ops/copy' );
```

#### copyOp( document, from, path )

Copies a value from one location to another with a deep clone.

```javascript
var doc = { 'foo': { 'bar': 1 } };
var out = copyOp( doc, '/foo/bar', '/baz' );
// returns { 'foo': { 'bar': 1 }, 'baz': 1 }
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->
